regressions.issue: Decoding the first returned uint256[] was a copy line and is now a word-copy while loop (P7). The second array was already a loop.
regressions.rule: A loop copying n consecutive words mem[d + 32i] = mem[s + 32i] with no other effect is one copy line, whatever symbolic base d and s share. Recognize it before or independent of expanding the free-memory base.

regressions.issue: Encoding loops are now bounded by raw memory reads (mem[128] for tokens.length, mem[32 * tokens.length + 160] for amounts.length) instead of the forwarded length or the temp, and ABI offsets keep _67 - mem[64] / _82 - mem[64] although _67 = mem[64] with no write in between.
regressions.rule: Forward the known memory word into a loop condition when the body writes no aliasing address (the floor of the free-memory pointer proves it); substitute v for mem[64] while v = mem[64] holds, so v - mem[64] folds to 0.

new_findings.issue: Named now, but a tuple with a dynamic member prints as the flat list of ABI words: head offsets (128, ceil32(L) + 448, 96, 288) and lengths look like arguments, and the struct fields and arrays aren't grouped, so values can't be matched to parameters.
new_findings.rule: When decoding against a signature, resolve each dynamic head word as an offset into the tail and print the tuple, bytes and arrays as values (as already done for Array(len=.., data=..)), never the offsets.

improvements: Calls named in swap (3 onSwap), joinPool/exitPool (onJoinPool/onExitPool with Array args, getSwapFeePercentage) and WETH deposit/withdraw; args-mem lines 44 -> 28. Logs decoded (Swap, PoolBalanceChanged, PoolBalanceManaged, ExternalBalanceTransfer). Many memory reads forwarded (mem[204 len 20] -> address(cd[singleSwap + 68]); pair keys sha3(Bytes(20, token0), Bytes(20, token1))); '- mem[64]' lines 88 -> 10. Dominated checks dropped: the BAL#500 arm under a same-iteration registered-pool check (managePoolBalance x3), repeated <= 2^64-1 checks of forwarded lengths. Dead return-data copies after ETH sends are removed (return _480). P6 3 -> 0, P4 header 2 -> 0. Copy loops 55 -> 51.
notes: Diff 5668 lines, reviewed by structure. The functions were reordered, so each of the 9 changed functions was cut from both texts. Call, storage-write, log and loop sequences are identical (registerTokens 17, flashLoan 18, queryBatchSwap 16, manageUserBalance 34, exitPool/joinPool 31, batchSwap 30, managePoolBalance 18), except swap: 4 encode loops became copy lines, and in join/exit the encode loop became a copy line while the decode copy became a loop. Every removed if/require is accounted for: constant-folded trailing-zero tests of 100/68-byte copies, the dominated BAL#500 arms, the forwarded-length requires, and the dead return-data copies. 8 new no-op 'mem[p + 36 len 28] = uint128(x >> 32)' write-backs of the selector insertion (same as c00097). 0 aborted.
summary: No semantic regression; calls, logs and forwarding improved widely. Two readability regressions: joinPool/exitPool's first returned array copy fell back from a copy line to a loop, and the registerTokens/flashLoan encoders now use raw memory loop bounds and unfolded '_v - mem[64]' offsets. swap's onSwap calls are named but print flat ABI words.
